run_exit_test: run the gRPC exit test suite to verify clean server client shutdown on interpreter exit
test_running_server: test that a running gRPC server exits cleanly when the Python interpreter shuts down
test_in_flight_unary_unary_call: test that an in-flight unary-unary gRPC call handles SIGINT and exits cleanly
test_poll_connectivity: test that polling channel connectivity exits cleanly without a running server
cleanup_processes: clean up all tracked subprocesses by killing them on atexit to prevent orphaned processes
